message.content: {"8": {"original": "accusing some technology business interests of attempting to pull stunts thatpun", "rephrased": "The Motion Picture Association of America asserts that certain technology companies are orchestrating disruptive online protests to punish their users and manipulate public opinion, rather than engaging in good-faith negotiations to address the genuine and damaging problem of online piracy.", "summary": "The Motion Picture Association of America condemns the online blackout as a manipulative stunt by tech companies that punishes users instead of solving piracy."}, "9": {"original": "claiming that the blackout actions are irresponsible, dangerous and a disservice", "rephrased": "The Motion Picture Association of America characterizes the planned global website shutdown as an irresponsible and dangerous act that harms ordinary people who depend on the internet for information, arguing that such tactics fail to address the real threat of copyright infringement.", "summary": "The Motion Picture Association of America condemns the website blackout as an irresponsible and dangerous tactic that harms the public."}}
